components.name: Owner React Control Surface
components.purpose: Present semantic Strategy, Artifact and Settings state with explicit feedback for blocked, running and completed Owner actions.

components.name: Strategy lifecycle domain
components.purpose: Own optimizer qualification, Challenger registration/lifecycle and Champion promotion/tenure semantics.

components.name: Optimizer job orchestration and read model
components.purpose: Persist editable draft separately from immutable job/resource requests, reconcile exact worker/MT5 launch identity, revalidate Windows RAM and commit headroom before launch, monitor only Job Object-owned process PrivateUsage, fail closed on pressure/telemetry loss, atomically publish round evidence, and serve bounded candidate projections without weakening canonical mutation verification.

components.name: Scientist advisory subsystem
components.purpose: Expose hash-verified static knowledge and bounded committed runtime context to an advisory LLM/chat workflow.

components.name: FastAPI runtime
components.purpose: Start migrations/recovery, route semantic APIs and expose overview/readiness.

components.name: Windows launcher/readiness
components.purpose: Verify or start canonical backend/frontend instances, reject invalid occupied ports and emit MAX_READY only after authority/readiness checks.

components.name: MT5/MetaEditor execution boundary
components.purpose: Provide Strategy Tester simulation/optimization and MQL5 compile/execution truth.

components.name: SQLite operational state
components.purpose: Persist mutable Strategy/Scientist operational state through owning stores and transactions.

components.name: Artifact control and safe state recovery
components.purpose: Keep ordinary artifact reads non-mutating and separate cleanup/reset/recovery into explicit, preflighted, ownership-bounded flows with visible UI state.

components.name: Immutable evidence/artifact layer
components.purpose: Represent runtime scientific/execution lineage owned by domain contracts; evidence/ and artifacts/ are runtime-only and intentionally absent from the public source repository.

components.name: Current project governance
components.purpose: Compile semantic specs plus code facts into reproducible canonical docs/ projections and validate sequence/project truth for the GitHub-hosted workflow.

data_flows.meaning: Owner events become semantic API requests; UI itself creates no domain authority.
Strategy actions are domain-validated before any SQLite/artifact/MT5 mutation.
MT5/MetaEditor execute simulation/optimization/compile while Python verifies legality and evidence.
Strategy evidence and lifecycle changes are governed through the owning domain and retained artifact lineage.
Debounced draft edits persist independently; START snapshots the validated draft into a new immutable job request.
data_flows.to: Optimizer job orchestration and read model

data_flows.from: Optimizer job orchestration and read model
data_flows.meaning: A confirmed worker executes one authorized round; frozen and verified evidence is atomically published before SQLite advances, then a bounded projection serves ordinary reads.

data_flows.from: Optimizer job orchestration and read model
data_flows.meaning: Candidate pages use the indexed projection; Challenger selection separately revalidates canonical retained evidence.
Scientist returns bounded advisory context only; no scientific/promotion authority.
Project Truth Compiler projects source facts plus explicit semantic authority deterministically into canonical docs/ Markdown.

external_boundaries.name: GitHub
external_boundaries.contract: maxqstudio/max-trading-agent main exact SHA is source authority; working branches are proposals until required hosted gates pass and merge.

external_boundaries.name: GitHub Actions
external_boundaries.contract: windows-latest is hosted build/test authority for source-only policy, Skill Workflow, backend, frontend, dependency and public-source validation; it does not prove real MT5 runtime.

external_boundaries.name: Owner PC
external_boundaries.contract: Final runtime/E2E authority only after GitHub development closure; real MT5, MetaEditor, broker data, terminal data root, deployment and browser E2E remain deferred.

external_boundaries.name: MetaTrader 5
external_boundaries.contract: Simulation and optimization execution truth only; Python validates workflow legality and evidence.

external_boundaries.name: MetaEditor
external_boundaries.contract: MQL5 compile truth used by promotion/deployment checks.

external_boundaries.name: Scientist provider
external_boundaries.contract: Untrusted/advisory provider output is bounded and cannot mutate Strategy authority.
